nodes.label: SEM / TEM / STEM
nodes.summary: The core imaging modes: surface (SEM), transmission through thin samples (TEM), and scanned-probe transmission (STEM).
sources: Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)

nodes.label: Resolution
nodes.summary: Smallest resolvable distance; modern aberration-corrected STEM reaches sub-Angstrom.
sources: Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)

nodes.label: Imaging conditions
nodes.summary: Acquisition parameters (kV, dose, detector, magnification) that shape every image and every ML label.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)
EM & XRM Connectomics Imaging & Experimental Metadata Standards (Wimbish 2024)

nodes.label: Metadata
nodes.summary: Structured record of imaging conditions and provenance attached to each dataset.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)
EM & XRM Connectomics Imaging & Experimental Metadata Standards (Wimbish 2024)

nodes.label: Data provenance
nodes.summary: The traceable history of how data was produced and processed.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)

nodes.label: FAIR principles
nodes.summary: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable data — the goal metadata standards enable.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)
EM & XRM Connectomics Imaging & Experimental Metadata Standards (Wimbish 2024)

nodes.label: Metadata standards
nodes.summary: Tiered specifications so imaging + experimental parameters are recorded consistently across labs.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)
EM & XRM Connectomics Imaging & Experimental Metadata Standards (Wimbish 2024)

nodes.label: Reproducibility & QC
nodes.summary: The ability to repeat and trust results, which complete metadata underpins.
sources: A Perspective on Microscopy Metadata: Provenance & Quality Control (Huisman 2019)

nodes.label: Connectomics / volumetric EM
nodes.summary: Reconstructing neural wiring from large 3D EM volumes; a driver of scale and standards.
sources: EM & XRM Connectomics Imaging & Experimental Metadata Standards (Wimbish 2024)
Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)

nodes.label: Deep learning in EM
nodes.summary: CNN/transformer models applied across acquisition, denoising, and analysis.
sources: Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)
ML for Electron & Scanning Probe Microscopy — Mic-Hackathon 2024

nodes.label: Segmentation
nodes.summary: Pixel- or object-level labeling of structures in EM images, increasingly by deep learning.
sources: Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)

nodes.label: U-Net / CNN architectures
nodes.summary: Encoder-decoder networks that dominate EM image segmentation.
sources: Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)
Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)

nodes.label: Annotation / labeling
nodes.summary: Human-made ground truth for training; the main bottleneck in large-scale EM ML.
sources: Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)

nodes.label: Self-/semi-supervised learning
nodes.summary: Techniques that cut the annotation burden by learning from unlabeled data.
sources: Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)

nodes.label: Public EM datasets
nodes.summary: Shared benchmark datasets that train and evaluate EM ML models.
sources: Segmentation in Large-Scale Cellular EM: A Literature Survey (Aswath 2023)
Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)

nodes.label: Denoising / restoration
nodes.summary: Recovering clean images from low-dose, noisy acquisitions using learned models.
sources: Review: Deep Learning in Electron Microscopy (Ede 2021)

nodes.label: Atom / defect detection
nodes.summary: Locating atoms and defects in atomic-resolution images for materials analysis.
sources: ML for Electron & Scanning Probe Microscopy — Mic-Hackathon 2024

nodes.label: Automated experimentation
nodes.summary: Closed-loop ML that steers the microscope during acquisition.
sources: ML for Electron & Scanning Probe Microscopy — Mic-Hackathon 2024
